title: Sphere Packing in High Dimensions
exact_target: Find the densest sphere packings in the remaining dimensions and determine how their optimal densities behave as the dimension grows.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1227 (GEO-032). CC BY 4.0.
Henry Cohn and Noam Elkies, \emph{New upper bounds on sphere packings I}, Annals of Mathematics 157 (2003), 689--714; arXiv:math/0110009v3, Section 1 and Appendix A.
